title: Chart quiz #15
caption:
Chart quiz #15. Three charts, three calls.

Q1: Uptrend, downtrend or range?
Q2: Which candle was the warning?
Q3: Which trade plan is better?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Trend #Candlesticks #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Trends, candles and trade plans. Question one. It's choppy, with some deep pullbacks. Is this an uptrend, a downtrend, or a range? An uptrend. Follow the swings, not the noise. Each high is higher than the last, and so is each low. Question two. After a long run up, three candles are marked. Which one was the warning sign? A, B, or C? B. A big red candle swallowed the one before it, at the top of a long run, on heavy volume. One candle is never a guarantee, but it's a clue worth respecting. Question three. Same entry, two plans. Green is the target, red is the stop. Is plan A better, or plan B? Plan B. Plan A risks as much as it can make. Plan B risks a little to make several times more. You can be wrong more often, and still come out ahead. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
